## CH03_S01_BEACH_NIGHT_DEBATE
Location: beach camp, forest edge (night)
Situation: Darkness becomes pressure; the camp debates shelter vs territorial signaling; strategy shifts to smaller approaches.
Playable interactions:
  - camp_build (non-claiming windbreak)
  - glow_control (dim / regulate)
  - plan_next_approach (small groups)
Quest hooks:
  1) Dim the Glow
     - Objective: reduce visibility without extinguishing safety light
     - Fail: panic spike / loss of cohesion
     - Reward: stealth discipline + trust opportunity
  2) Shelter Without Claim
     - Objective: build temporary cover with no posts, no walls, no perimeter
     - Fail: perceived territorial escalation
     - Reward: camp comfort + lower threat signature

## CH03_S02_APPROACH_FAILURES
Location: corridor to tree line (day)
Situation: Early approaches trigger warning displays; retreat is enforced; learning becomes data collection.
Playable interactions:
  - posture_trial (kneel/open hands/back-turned)
  - retreat_logging (direction/speed/hesitation)
Quest hooks:
  1) Measure the Retreat
     - Objective: record patterns of flight and warning behavior
     - Reward: “giant_reaction_map” intel flag
  2) Nonthreat Posture Library
     - Objective: test 3 postures at 3 distances
     - Reward: “approach_protocol_v1” unlocked

## CH03_S03_OFFERING_STONES
Location: tree line boundary
Situation: Patterned stones are left as offerings; not destroyed implies recognition.
Playable interactions:
  - arrange_symbols (spiral/wave/ring)
  - check_reply (later inspection)
Quest hooks:
  1) Vocabulary of Shapes
     - Objective: test which symbols reduce fear / increase watching time
     - Reward: “pattern_vocabulary_v1”
  2) Silent Reply
     - Objective: detect whether stones are re-ordered or mirrored
     - Reward: “giant_signal_response” flag

## CH03_S04_WATER_SPIRAL_DIALOGUE
Location: shallows
Situation: Torhh kneels, hand in water; Kyreth shapes a spiral; Torhh responds; shared interference patterns become dialogue.
Playable interactions:
  - shared_medium_water (shape, respond, stabilize)
  - focus_under_fear (maintain pattern after startle)
Quest hooks:
  1) Spiral and Response (primary)
     - Objective: match Torhh’s ripples with stable spirals for 10 cycles
     - Fail: chaotic collapse (fear reset)
     - Reward: Trust_Torhh + “shared_medium_water” unlocked
  2) Hold Focus Under Fear
     - Objective: keep pattern stable after a sudden stimulus
     - Reward: “discipline_focus_v1”

## CH03_S05_PROTOCOL_EMERGES_SAND
Location: wet/dry boundary on beach
Situation: A second Giant joins and shapes sand; water patterns begin translating to earth medium; observers join.
Playable interactions:
  - translate_medium (water → sand)
  - boundary_respect (distance discipline)
Quest hooks:
  1) Translate Medium
     - Objective: recreate 2 water patterns in sand with the Copper-Toned Giant
     - Reward: “shared_medium_sand” unlocked
  2) Emotion Light Control
     - Objective: test glow intensity vs Giant curiosity
     - Reward: “glow_feedback_curve” flag

## CH03_S06_FIRST_TONGUE_SETUP
Location: sunset assembly
Situation: Patience directive; Senareth declares the next step: sound-pattern language, first words of the First Tongue.
Playable interactions:
  - tone_testing (distance/volume/cadence)
  - tri_modal_mapping (sound ↔ ripple ↔ mark)
Quest hooks:
  1) Sound Without Threat
     - Objective: identify 3 tones that do not trigger retreat
     - Reward: “tone_safe_set_v1”
  2) Shared Alphabet
     - Objective: bind tone to a ripple and to a sand-mark
     - Reward: “first_tongue_seed” unlocked
